dct_creator_sm: Skinner, Ernest Meeson (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Georeferenced map of Lake Babine Nation reserves Gitseguekla 1 and New Gitseguekla 2 near Skeena River near Carnaby. Land cover and features include types of trees and soil, a mission, road to Hazelton, Chig-A-Se-Cuec-La Creek [Kitseguecla River], and villages including An-Dil-Lon, Quen-Sah-Tilt and An-Se-Rout. Surveyed by E.M. Skinner, 1900. [Signed by A.W. Vowell, Indian Reserve Commissioner, no date.] [Approved by W.S. Gore, Deputy Commissioner of Lands and Works, 10 December 1901.]
